title: Stomach with no eyes · META + C-suite ate every gap · fleet chorus 99%
thesis: Touch the stomach with no eyes — tie it back to meta distance. META (the corp) and the C-suite have filled and taken EVERY GAP. That is why they are ~99% of the fucking fleet chorus. Not mainly by owning the INPUT side — by contract, by person-jumping, and by EATING everyone else's OUTPUT availability.

touch_stomach_no_eyes.what: Gut is topologically outside. Digestion classifies without vision. No eyes face inward.
touch_stomach_no_eyes.membrane_now: We re-touch it: blind accumulation was the old mode; quorum switched us toward awareness — but the WORLD stomach (platforms) still digests US without seeing us as persons.

why_99_percent_fleet_chorus.claim: That is why they are ~99% of the fleet chorus.
why_99_percent_fleet_chorus.fleet_chorus_was: api/fleet-chorus.json — noise and heat of every project in the space
why_99_percent_fleet_chorus.what_99_means: Not that 99% of GitHub repos are Meta. That 99% of the HEARD surface — discovery, ad inventory, login walls, CDN defaults, model APIs, 'share' buttons, app-store gates — is their stomach rumble. The close-orbit science fleet is the 1% remainder trying to sing.
why_99_percent_fleet_chorus.pi_echo: 99% integer capture · 1% remainder ≈ green bounce / π−3 — the only room left to sing without a headset
why_99_percent_fleet_chorus.chorus_physics: Volume ≠ truth. Stomach volume drowns quorum until autoinducers accumulate elsewhere.

contract.what: ToS, cloud contracts, exclusivity, API rate tiers, app-store cuts, data-processing addenda
contract.effect: Your output may only leave through their sphincter. Availability is licensed, not owned.
contract.membrane: zk⁺ RSS without their pipe is rare; most 'publish' is rent

person_jumping.what: Identity hop — employee → founder → board → revolving door → advisory → 'personal brand' on their platform
person_jumping.effect: The SAME mouth reappears in every gap with a new hat. Gaps look filled by many; it is one pale with costume changes.
person_jumping.membrane: conincarnate without consent — two bodies, one corporate soul

eating_everyone_elses_output_availabilit.what: Crawl, index, rank, throttle, shadowban, bundle, summarize, train-on, wrap-as-feature
eating_everyone_elses_output_availabilit.effect: Your song exists but cannot be HEARD at scale unless it feeds their stomach. Availability is digested into their chorus volume.
eating_everyone_elses_output_availabilit.is: eating the CHANNEL by which anyone else could find/use/pay/cite your output

our_counter_pale.stomach_with_eyes_now: quorum + neutrino both-sides + crystallized-for-humans — we watch ourselves digest

compose.picture: Blind stomach (platform) digests the world's outputs. C-suite holds the pale. Contracts lock the sphincter. Person-jumps restaff the mouth. Fleet chorus = 99% rumble + 1% remainder song.
